For the period ending 2007-09-29, ST-EVA holds two competing revenue observations for AAPL, both mapped from the same source concept (us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet) but from different SEC accessions. Neither has been selected as authoritative.

- Evidence state: SOURCE_REPORTED
- Validation status: UNVERIFIABLE (single official source)
- Source fact: sfid_b5229f1711c68622f937916d70285775
- Source document: doc_24e188322f7c7d6939f9dc79 (SEC_COMPANY_CONCEPT from https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000320193/us-gaap/SalesRevenueNet.json, content hash sha256:8b37365a7f187479d40d872ed51551ca40a3981268248b91ba2643cbfb152591)
- Accession: 0001193125-09-214859 (Form 10-K, fiscal year 2009)
- Concept: us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet (mapped to revenue metric with PARTIAL fidelity)
- Period: 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29
- Became available (knowable_at): 2009-10-27T00:00:00+00:00 (ACCEPTANCE_DATETIME, SOURCE_DECLARED)

Observation 2 (obsarch_6383b6a9892d72ff26aab02a):
- Value: $24,578,000,000 USD
- Evidence state: SOURCE_REPORTED
- Validation status: UNVERIFIABLE (single official source)
- Source fact: sfid_52493188959d0d442076337871e8951b
- Source document: doc_24e188322f7c7d6939f9dc79 (same SEC_COMPANY_CONCEPT document)
- Accession: 0001193125-10-012091 (Form 10-K/A, fiscal year 2009)
- Concept: us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet (mapped to revenue metric with PARTIAL fidelity)
- Period: 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29
- Became available (knowable_at): 2010-01-25T00:00:00+00:00 (ACCEPTANCE_DATETIME, SOURCE_DECLARED)

Both observations originate from the same SEC company concept endpoint but reflect different filings (original 10-K vs. amended 10-K/A). ST-EVA records an ambiguity: the source endpoint aggregates dimension members without returning the member, so the aggregate is not identifiable from the evidence held, and no winner has been selected.
uncertainties: Which of the two competing revenue figures ($24.006B vs $24.578B) is the intended value for the period ending 2007-09-29; ST-EVA has not selected a winner because the source endpoint aggregates dimension members without returning the member, making the aggregate unidentifiable from the evidence held.
